pr.title: refactor(gaia): split /gaia router into discrete /gaia-* commands and migrate all references
pr.body:
## What

Replaces the `/gaia <subcommand>` router with discrete `/gaia-*` entries so every GAIA workflow shows up in slash-command autocomplete — the old router gave new users no menu hints — then migrates **every** `/gaia <sub>` reference across the repo to the new form.

| Entry | Type | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `/gaia-plan`, `/gaia-spec`, `/gaia-audit`, `/gaia-fitness`, `/gaia-forensics` | command | human-invoked only |
| `/gaia-wiki` | skill | autocompletes **and** stays agent-invocable for the wiki-CI workflow |
| `/gaia-handoff`, `/gaia-pickup` | skill | autocomplete + natural-language trigger |

The `gaia` router `SKILL.md` is removed. Every entry dispatches into the **unchanged** `references/*` instructions — workflow logic is untouched. Sub-arguments are unchanged: `/gaia-wiki sync`, `/gaia-spec auto`, `/gaia-audit --apply`.

## Why `wiki` is a skill, not a command

The wiki-CI workflow (`gaia-ci-wiki.yml.tmpl`) and the manual smoke tests drive an **autonomous** Claude agent through `/gaia-wiki sync|consolidate|lint`. Agents invoke *skills* (Skill tool), not slash *commands* (a human-typing affordance). So `wiki` must stay skill-shaped; it's the only workflow with an autonomous caller.

## Commit 1 — functional surfaces (`bf9a6d7`)

- CI wiki workflow template + its snapshot test
- 5 manual smoke-test prompts (fixtures now install the `gaia-wiki` skill)
- wiki hook nudge strings, release `preflight.ts` messages, spec-kit dispatch doc
- user-facing emit strings inside `references/*` (e.g. spec abort/resume hints, lint "Run /gaia-wiki sync")
- manifest regenerated

## Commit 2 — repo-wide reference migration (`24eb98d`)

Guarded sweep (`/gaia <sub>` → `/gaia-<sub>` only when the slash is **not** preceded by an alphanumeric char, so CLI/path forms are skipped) across 56 files / 211 replacements:

- `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, all `wiki/**` prose (concepts, decisions, index, overview, dependencies)
- `.specify/**` extension + preset (commands, templates, tests, `extension.yml`, `specs.json`)
- `.gaia/tests/**/README.md`, `.gaia/templates/README.md`, `.gaia/release-exclude`
- `.github/forensics/*` handler strings, `.claude/commands/*` + `wiki-style.md`
- CLI src comments/jsdoc (`index.ts`, `wiki/index.ts`, `wikilinks.ts`)
- `taxonomy.md` — surgical: only the two current-state advice lines; the "Prior:" ledger is left intact
- maintainer binary + `gaia-ci-wiki.yml.tmpl` regenerated from already-migrated src

**Left intact:** CLI no-slash forms (`gaia wiki sync land`, `.gaia/cli/gaia wiki diff-size`); `CHANGELOG.md` and dated `wiki/meta/lint-report-*.md` (historical record).

## Verification

- `.gaia/cli` typecheck ✓
- full cli vitest suite (1232 tests, 1 skipped) ✓ — no snapshot regen needed
- guarded grep: zero residual slash-forms outside the intentionally-excluded historical files; zero CLI-form corruption
- `specs.json` valid JSON; all touched shell scripts pass `bash -n`
- all required CI green on `24eb98d`; GAIA-Audit marker matches HEAD tree

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

commit.message:
refactor(gaia): split /gaia router into discrete /gaia-* commands and skills

Surface every GAIA workflow as its own slash entry so they appear in
slash-command autocomplete, instead of hiding behind a `/gaia <sub>`
router that gave no menu hints to new users.

- Commands (human-invoked): /gaia-plan, /gaia-spec, /gaia-audit,
  /gaia-fitness, /gaia-forensics
- Skills (autocomplete + agent/NL-invocable): /gaia-wiki, /gaia-handoff,
  /gaia-pickup. gaia-wiki stays a skill so the wiki-CI Claude agent can
  still invoke it; handoff/pickup also natural-language trigger.
- Remove the `gaia` router SKILL.md. Every entry dispatches into the
  unchanged references/* instructions — workflow logic is untouched.
  Sub-args unchanged: /gaia-wiki sync, /gaia-spec auto, /gaia-audit --apply.

Rename /gaia <sub> -> /gaia-<sub> across functional surfaces: CI wiki
workflow template (+ snapshot), 5 manual smoke-test prompts (fixtures now
install the gaia-wiki skill), wiki hook nudge strings, release preflight
messages, spec-kit dispatch doc, and user-facing emit strings inside
references/*. CLI forms (`gaia wiki sync land`) left intact. Manifest
regenerated.

Prose docs (README, CONTRIBUTING, wiki/**, health taxonomy, forensics
labels) still reference the old form and are handled separately.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor(gaia): migrate residual /gaia <sub> refs to /gaia-<sub>

Complete the command split: sweep every remaining `/gaia <sub>` router
form to the discrete `/gaia-<sub>` commands across README, CONTRIBUTING,
wiki prose, .specify extension/preset, .gaia tests + templates, forensics
handlers, and CLI src comments/help text. Guarded replacement skips
CLI/path forms (`.gaia/cli/gaia wiki ...`, `cli/gaia wiki`).

Rebuild the maintainer binary + regenerate the gaia-ci-wiki workflow
template from already-migrated src (picks up `/gaia-wiki sync first`
preflight string and the workflow prompt stages).

CHANGELOG and dated wiki/meta lint reports left untouched as historical
record; taxonomy.md Prior ledger preserved (only current-state advice
lines updated).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
refactor(gaia): split /gaia router into discrete /gaia-* commands and skills

Surface every GAIA workflow as its own slash entry so they appear in
slash-command autocomplete, instead of hiding behind a `/gaia <sub>`
router that gave no menu hints to new users.

- Commands (human-invoked): /gaia-plan, /gaia-spec, /gaia-audit,
  /gaia-fitness, /gaia-forensics
- Skills (autocomplete + agent/NL-invocable): /gaia-wiki, /gaia-handoff,
  /gaia-pickup. gaia-wiki stays a skill so the wiki-CI Claude agent can
  still invoke it; handoff/pickup also natural-language trigger.
- Remove the `gaia` router SKILL.md. Every entry dispatches into the
  unchanged references/* instructions — workflow logic is untouched.
  Sub-args unchanged: /gaia-wiki sync, /gaia-spec auto, /gaia-audit --apply.

Rename /gaia <sub> -> /gaia-<sub> across functional surfaces: CI wiki
workflow template (+ snapshot), 5 manual smoke-test prompts (fixtures now
install the gaia-wiki skill), wiki hook nudge strings, release preflight
messages, spec-kit dispatch doc, and user-facing emit strings inside
references/*. CLI forms (`gaia wiki sync land`) left intact. Manifest
regenerated.

Prose docs (README, CONTRIBUTING, wiki/**, health taxonomy, forensics
labels) still reference the old form and are handled separately.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
